Japanese Food - Japanese Style Hamburger in the heart of Saigon
Jan 2024 • Friends
With Japanese style, every food is very delicious. Specially, Hamburger & BBQ, and spinach salad (must-try). Staffs' attitude are very nice and supportive.
With Japanese style food, the food here is very delicious and delicious. In particular, you should try Hambergu & BBQ stir-fried beef or Shaking Beef, served with a very delicious spinach mixed salad. The staff attitude here is also very welcoming and enthusiastically supportive. It is not difficult to find a good restaurant in the heart of Saigon. What a lovely experience here!
